question: Which world-groups are placed in ego, space-ego, and the tanmātra domain?
premises: In ego there is a group of eight beginning with Chagala.
Within the domain of space and ego-maker there is another group of eight.
That inner group includes tanmātra, sun, moon, and śruti worlds of the intellect and action gods.
inference: The compendium continues upward by assigning an eightfold group to ego and another eightfold group to the inner space-ego and tanmātra domain.
uncertainties: The exact parsing of the long compound in the first token is compressed.
plain_english: In ego there is the group of eight beginning with Chagala. Then, within the domain of space and ego-maker, there is the group of eight worlds of the tanmātras, sun, moon, and śruti, belonging to the gods of intellect and action.
